title: Longest match on operators
brief: Print a name for each operator in the input, one per line: + is PLUS, ++ is INCR, += is ADD_ASSIGN, = is ASSIGN, and == is EQ. Ignore everything else.
hints: flex always prefers the longest match, so you do not have to order these carefully.
Quote multi-character operators, as in "++". An unquoted + means one or more of something.
Finish with .|\n and an empty action, or the default rule will echo the other characters.
explanation: Flex tries to extend every match as far as possible. On +++ it takes ++ first, because that is the longest match from the start of the input, and only then sees the last +. This is why C reads x+++y as x++ + y.
